uni_freecam.setting.speed.tooltip: How fast the camera flies. The mouse wheel changes it while flying, until you leave freecam.
uni_freecam.setting.sprint.tooltip: How much faster the camera goes while the sprint key is held.
uni_freecam.setting.noclip.tooltip: When off, the camera stops at solid blocks and slides along them.
uni_freecam.setting.smooth.tooltip: Ease into and out of motion instead of moving at full speed at once.
uni_freecam.setting.fly_look.tooltip: Forward follows the look direction, up and down included. When off, forward stays level.
